This is a senior, quota-carrying position suited to an established business development professional with a strong network across the Cyprus market and a proven track record of selling IT services, ERP or enterprise software solutions. The successful candidate will take ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying opportunities through to proposal development, commercial negotiation and closing. The role will focus primarily on Cyprus, with selective responsibility for opportunities across Greece and the wider Middle East. MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Generate qualified business opportunities through an established professional network and develop a sustainable personal sales pipeline. Sell ERP, Microsoft technology, automation and AI services to mid-market and enterprise organisations. Develop and maintain strong relationships with referral partners, professional services firms and other relevant stakeholders. Own the full sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation and contract closure. Work closely with the delivery team to scope solutions that are both commercially competitive and operationally deliverable. Lead commercial negotiations in collaboration with the COO and senior management. Represent the organisation at industry events Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline visibility and sales forecasts. Provide regular reporting on sales activity, opportunity progression and expected closing dates. Monitor market developments and provide insight into competitor activity, pricing trends and emerging client requirements. Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships following initial engagement. CANDIDATE PROFILE 10+ years' experience in B2B sales, including at least 5 years selling IT services, ERP or enterprise software within Cyprus. An established network of senior decision-makers within Cyprus-based organisations and their professional advisory networks. Demonstrable experience generating and closing significant services or technology deals. A strong track record of achieving sales targets and developing new business. Working knowledge of ERP and cloud services Fluent English and Greek, both written and spoken. Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills. Comfortable working autonomously in a results-driven environment. Willingness to travel regularly within Cyprus and occasionally across the region. Experience selling Microsoft Dynamics, particularly Business Central, NAV or Finance & Operations. Experience selling another mid-market ERP platform Existing relationships within the Microsoft partner ecosystem in Cyprus and/or Greece. Previous experience with a systems integrator, Microsoft partner or advisory practice within a professional services or audit firm. An established network within financial services, shipping, maritime, trade or construction sectors. Experience selling professional or managed IT services to enterprise and mid-market clients. A strong delivery organisation and established client reference base. Direct access to senior management for pricing, commercial terms and deal structuring, enabling fast decision-making. Uncapped commission with significant earning potential for high-performing sales professionals. A senior-level position with substantial autonomy and direct impact on business growth. SALARY AND BENEFITS Salary will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and skills. The advertised salary range is indicative, any offer will reflect the successful candidate’s suitability. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive at GRS Recruitment, only shortlisted candidates will be responded to. To apply for this position, please email your CV to Laura Saltyte, lauras@grsrecruitment.com quoting the above job reference or call +357 25 342 734 for further information.

review_candidates.title: Senior Accountant
review_candidates.description: WHO WE ARE At Flying Wild Hog, we create action games that players remember. Since 2009, we've built a reputation for fast-paced gameplay, memorable worlds, and experiences that throw players straight into the heart of the action. From the explosive Shadow Warrior and Hard Reset series to the artistic journey of Trek to Yomi and the weird-west mayhem of Evil West , we've always believed gameplay comes first. Today, we're pushing that ambition even further as we develop Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis in partnership with Crystal Dynamics. Headquartered in Poland and powered by talent from around the world, we're a team of passionate creators who love solving creative challenges, experimenting with new ideas, and building games we'd want to play ourselves. We are on the hunt for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Accountant to join our ambitious finance team. As we push the boundaries of creativity and technology, we seek a financial expert to oversee our accounting processes, ensuring the stability and growth that support our next blockbuster games. ABOUT THE POSITION As a Senior Accountant at Flying Wild Hog, you will manage the accounting function. You will be responsible for complex accounting operations, tax compliance, and financial reporting. Working closely with the PLAION capital group and internal departments, you will play a key role in month-end and year-end closings, process optimization, and providing strategic financial insights to support the studio's growth. RESPONSIBILITIES Independent management of accounting records for Flying Wild Hog companies in the SAP system, ensuring high-quality, accurate data entry and classification. Ensuring full compliance of all financial transactions with Polish tax regulations (VAT, CIT, PIT, etc.) and accounting standards. Supporting the month-end and year-end closing processes, overseeing accuracy and deadlines in collaboration with the PLAION capital group. Coordinating tax reporting processes, including preparation of complex VAT returns (JPK) and other statutory filings. Acting as a senior point of contact and financial partner for internal departments, providing guidance on financial workflows. Proactive participation in financial statement preparation and management reviews, offering analysis and recommendations. Leading initiatives to optimize accounting processes and improve document circulation efficiency. Mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge to elevate the finance team’s standards. REQUIREMENTS Master’s degree in Finance & Accounting / Taxes or a related economic field. Significant professional experience in independent accounting, including proven success in managing month-end/year-end closing processes. Expert-level knowledge of Polish tax regulations and accounting standards. Very high proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel), advanced experience with the SAP system will be a plus. Fluent English (written and spoken) used daily in a professional environment. Ability to work independently with a high degree of responsibility and proactive problem-solving skills. Strong analytical mindset and an interest in process improvement. WE OFFER Possibility to work 100% remote Private medical care (entirely financed by the Hogs) Sports Card (FitProfit card) Hog’s Academy - development budget Professional mental health support Language lessons (Polish and English) Flexible working hours (core hours 11:00-16:00) The team consists of experienced veterans, which means huge development Working environment based on a strong team spirit and positive energy

review_candidates.description: Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio per la sicurezza globale. L’azienda ha una significativa presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia e Stati Uniti e opera in 150 Paesi anche attraverso controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Leonardo è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese All’interno della Divisione Spazio , nell’ Unità Organizzativa Opto-Mechanical & Thermal Engineering, stiamo ricercando un/a Analista Termico per la nostra sede di Nerviano (MI) La persona opererà come Analista Termico per i programmi della Divisione Spazio, in particolare per tutti i progetti della Business Area Robotics & Equipments. La persona si occuperà di : Effettuare analisi termiche di tipo architetturale, stazionario e transitorio, ai fini di dimostrare la compliance del design termo-meccanico rispetto ai carichi ambientali dovuti all’ambiente termico orbitale. Sarà coordinata dagli architetti termo-strutturali che gestiscono il design dei programmi e si interfaccerà anche con i tecnici del cliente. Seguire i test di ciclatura termica in vuoto e di correlazione (Thermal Balance Test), validi per lo sviluppo, la qualifica e l’accettazione dello strumento, assicurandosi di avere un setup idoneo allo scopo e interfacciandosi con gli altri reparti che gestiscono facility e AIT di strumento. Titolo di studio: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica e/o Aerospaziale. Competenze comportamentali: Team working Organizzazione e precisione Orientamento al risultato Gestione del tempo e delle scadenze Conoscenze linguistiche: Inglese (liv. min. B2) Competenze informatiche: Windows, suite Office, CATIA V5, Suite Altair (Hypermesh, Hyperview, etc) per analisi termiche FEM, ESATAN/THERMICA SYSTEMA/THERMAL DESKTOP per analisi termiche con modelli alle differenze finite. Altro: Si richiede disponibilità per trasferte di breve durata in ambito nazionale ed internazionale Coinvolgimento, valorizzazione delle competenze , cura del benessere e della sicurezza delle persone sono i cardini della nostra cultura aziendale. Ci impegniamo ogni giorno a favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e stimolante , promuovendo attivamente i principi di inclusione, equità e valorizzazione delle diversità. Cosa offriamo? L’azienda si riserva la possibilità di effettuare valutazioni in merito al livello di inquadramento e alla proposta economica, sulla base di criteri oggettivi emersi nel corso del processo di selezione e in coerenza con la seniority del/della candidato/a individuato/a e della posizione, nel rispetto dei principi di equità, trasparenza e pari opportunità previsti dalla normativa vigente. Aspettiamo la tua candidatura: inviaci il tuo CV entro tre settimane dall’apertura dell’annuncio di lavoro. Come funziona il processo di selezione? Le/i candidate/i selezionate/i sostengono un colloquio conoscitivo con il team delle Risorse Umane, motivazionale e attitudinale, seguito da un’intervista di approfondimento tecnico con il Business. Al termine del processo, alla persona viene restituito un feedback, sia in caso di esito positivo che negativo.
